predecessors.name: Qing dynasty
predecessors.text: Tannu Uriankhai: 'The end of Qing rule in Tannu Uriankhai came quickly' after the Xinhai Revolution of 10 October 1911; infobox disestablishment December 1911

successors.name: Russian Empire
successors.text: the republic as a Russian protectorate under the name Uryankhay Krai: 'On 14 April 1914, the Uryankhay Republic became a Russian protectorate as the Uryankhay Krai'

ledger.x: 1911: the Tuvan nobles proclaim an Uryankhay republic.
April 1914: Uryankhay becomes a Russian protectorate.
April 1914: the republic ends as a state; the Uryankhay Krai is a Russian protectorate (successor: Uryankhay Krai in the infobox).

wars.name: Russian intervention in Uryankhay
wars.outcome: Russian troops entered in 1912 on the pretext of attacks on Russian migrants; two khoshuuns petitioned in fall 1913 to join Russia and the republic became a protectorate on 14 April 1914.

certainty.note: No boundary is described; the banner list (Tannu, Salajik, Tojin, Khovsgol Nuur, Khemchik) is undated.
